15. The law firm employs trainee lawyers who work under senior lawyers for one year and then 
sit an examination. On successful completion, they become full lawyers.
The TraineeLawyer class has been created. A trainee lawyer is a lawyer with two additional 
attributes: joining date and exam status.
(a) (i)   Identify a suitable data type for each additional attribute in the TraineeLawyer 
class. [2]
(ii) Construct a detailed class diagram including attributes, methods, and relationship.
The diagram must include the Lawyer class and the TraineeLawyer class. [4]
(b) (i)   State the relationship between the TraineeLawyer class and the Lawyer class. [1]
(ii) State the relationship between the Lawyer class and the Case class. [1]
(iii) Describe the difference between the two relationships stated in part (b)(i) and 
part (b)(ii). [4]
(c) Outline what is meant by the term encapsulation. [2]
(d) Define the term parent object. [1]
(Option D continues on the following page)
